description: This script generates operator lists and related files for a PyTorch mobile build, including extracting operators from model definitions, handling selective build configurations, and generating C++ registration code.

classes.name: SelectiveBuilder
classes.description: Represents a collection of selected operators for use in a PyTorch build, constructed from YAML dicts and supporting combination of multiple builders.

methods.name: set[str] extract_all_operators(selective_builder: SelectiveBuilder)
methods.description: Returns a set of all operator names included in the selective builder.

methods.name: set[str] extract_training_operators(selective_builder: SelectiveBuilder)
methods.description: Returns a set of operator names used for training, based on the selective builder.

methods.name: None throw_if_any_op_includes_overloads(selective_builder: SelectiveBuilder)
methods.description: Raises an exception if any operator in the builder includes all overloads, unless explicitly allowed.

methods.name: None gen_supported_mobile_models(model_dicts: list[Any], output_dir: str)
methods.description: Generates C++ code to register supported mobile models based on model debug info and MD5 hashes.

methods.name: None main(argv: list[Any])
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, parsing arguments, loading model files, generating operator lists, and invoking code generation functions.
